verdict.rationale: The dashboard guide documents creating a dedicated API key for each agent and revoking it independently. That isolates credentials per agent, but nothing shows keys can be limited to specific endpoints, actions, or spend. missing for 10: permission/scope restrictions on keys (e.g. read-only or job-create-only), per-key spend or rate limits, expiry/TTL options, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Create a dedicated API key for each agent, script, or pipeline. If one key is exposed or retired, you can revoke it without breaking other integrations.
